title: Benchmarking data-driven material models on the classic Treloar dataset
abstract: arXiv:2608.14063v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning is rapidly reshaping constitutive modeling, offers new ways to learn material behavior directly from experimental data, and challenges long-established modeling paradigms. But with a growing number of machine-learning-based approaches available, how do they compare in practice? In this paper, we use the classic experimental data of Treloar to benchmark popular frameworks for hyperelasticity: (Generalized-Invariant) Constitutive Artificial Neural Networks, Physics-Augmented Neural Networks, (Adaptive) Material Fingerprinting, and Efficient Unsupervised Constitutive Law Identification & Discovery. We compare their fitting performance, computational cost, hyperparameter sensitivity, and ease of implementation. Furthermore, we discuss the trade-offs between predictive accuracy and model complexity. The latter is assessed by quantifying both the number of material parameters in the discovered models and the computational time

translated_title: 基于经典Treloar数据集的数据驱动材料模型基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14063v1 公告类型：新 摘要：机器学习正在迅速重塑本构建模，提供了直接从实验数据中学习材料行为的新方法，并挑战了长期确立的建模范式。但随着基于机器学习的方法数量不断增加，它们在实践中如何比较？在本文中，我们使用Treloar的经典实验数据来基准测试超弹性的流行框架：（广义不变量）本构人工神经网络、物理增强神经网络、（自适应）材料指纹识别，以及高效无监督本构律识别与发现。我们比较了它们的拟合性能、计算成本、超参数敏感性和实现简易性。此外，我们讨论了预测精度与模型复杂度之间的权衡。后者通过量化所发现模型中的材料参数数量和计算时间来评估。
tldr: 本文利用经典Treloar数据集系统比较了多种机器学习超弹性本构模型框架，评估了其拟合性能、计算成本、超参数敏感性和实现难度，并探讨了预测精度与模型复杂度之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks multiple machine-learning hyperelastic constitutive models on the classic Treloar dataset, comparing fitting performance, computational cost, hyperparameter sensitivity, and implementation ease, while discussing trade-offs between predictive accuracy and model complexity.
